statusDefinitions.ready: Dependencies are done and an agent may execute it.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Cannot proceed; statusReason explains the blocker.
statusDefinitions.awaiting_human: Requires a real person, device, physical print or store account.
statusDefinitions.done: Acceptance, checks and evidence are complete.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.goal: A reproducible, agent-operable Flutter repository that builds on Android and iOS.

milestones.title: Geometry and PDF spike
milestones.goal: Prove exact physical layout and generate a deterministic sample PDF.

milestones.title: Usable MVP flow
milestones.goal: Select, configure, crop/fit, preview and export one image.

milestones.title: Physical validation
milestones.goal: Guide 100% printing and validate a real calibration sheet.

milestones.title: Lifetime purchase
milestones.goal: One free export followed by a non-consumable unlock.

milestones.title: Store release
milestones.goal: Localise, package, validate and submit version 1.0.

tasks.title: Create the agent operating system
tasks.objective: Persist product context, architecture, task state and universal agent commands in the repository.
acceptance: AGENTS.md defines startup, task, PR, scope, privacy and human-gate rules.
project/plan.json is machine-readable and validates without third-party Python packages.
tool/project.py exposes doctor, validate, status, next, show, verify and render-status.
The CLI has automated tests.

tasks.title: Create the Flutter application shell
tasks.objective: Provide a minimal product-shaped Flutter app with strict analysis and widget tests.
acceptance: The app starts through PhotoCutApp and renders the core product promise.
The initial action does not claim photo selection is implemented.
Widget tests cover the shell and temporary foundation message.
Flutter and Dart versions are pinned in repository files.

tasks.title: Commit and verify Android/iOS platform scaffolds
tasks.objective: Generate deterministic platform folders with the provisional bundle ID and prove both target builds in CI.
acceptance: android/ and ios/ are committed rather than generated only in an agent workspace.
Android uses minimum SDK 24 and application ID com.frainzzel.photocut.
iOS uses deployment target 15.0 and bundle ID com.frainzzel.photocut.
CI builds a debug Android APK and an unsigned iOS simulator app.
pubspec.lock and Flutter metadata are committed.
verification: GitHub Actions CI run 33777871880: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33777871880: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Model physical lengths and paper sizes
tasks.objective: Create explicit, tested value types for millimetres, centimetres, inches and PDF points.
acceptance: No public domain API accepts an ambiguous naked length double.
A4, US Letter and 10 x 15 cm presets expose exact dimensions.
Round-trip conversion tests stay within 0.001 mm.
Invalid, zero, NaN and infinite lengths are rejected.
verification: GitHub Actions CI run 33780112176: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33780112176: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Implement repeated-photo sheet layout
tasks.objective: Lay out a requested number of equal photo boxes over one or more pages.
acceptance: Margins, gaps and copy count are respected.
No placed rectangle overlaps or leaves the printable page box.
Automatic page orientation chooses the arrangement with the greatest capacity, then deterministic tie-breakers.
Overflow creates the minimum number of pages for the chosen grid.
A 35 x 45 mm, eight-copy A4 scenario is covered by tests.
verification: GitHub Actions CI run 33794909155: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33794909155: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Generate the exact-size sample PDF
tasks.objective: Render the layout plan into a PDF without duplicating geometry logic in the renderer.
acceptance: The pdf dependency and licence are documented and locked.
The PDF page box matches the selected paper size.
Placed image boxes match the sheet plan within 0.1 mm.
A deterministic 35 x 45 mm, eight-copy A4 sample is produced in CI.
The renderer supports synthetic image bytes in tests.
verification: GitHub Actions CI run 33797250917: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33797250917: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Add PDF preview and share spike
tasks.objective: Prove that the generated bytes can be previewed, shared and handed to native printing.
acceptance: The printing dependency and licence are documented and locked.
A development-only spike screen previews the deterministic sample.
Share and print operations are behind a gateway with a fake.
Android and iOS builds remain green.

tasks.title: Select one image robustly
tasks.objective: Select a gallery image and recover Android lost-data cases without retaining private data unnecessarily.
acceptance: image_picker is isolated behind a gateway.
Cancel is handled without an error state.
Android lost data is checked at startup.
iOS photo-library description is present and accurate.
Tests use synthetic files and a fake gateway.
verification: GitHub Actions preparation run 33905836030: analysis and focused tests — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33905993143: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33905993143: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Build the print-job configuration flow
tasks.objective: Collect dimensions, units, paper, copies, margin, gap and cut-mark preferences with clear validation.
acceptance: The session state is immutable and independent from widgets.
Width, height and copy count have accessible validation errors.
Changing units preserves the physical size.
Defaults make the first successful preview fast.
Widget tests cover valid and invalid paths.
verification: GitHub Actions preparation run 33908511625: analysis and focused tests — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33908672038: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 33908672038: iOS simulator build — success

tasks.title: Implement crop-to-fill and fit-inside
tasks.objective: Let users control how their image maps into the exact output rectangle.
acceptance: Crop state is stored as normalised source coordinates.
Fit-inside never distorts the source aspect ratio.
Crop-to-fill produces the requested aspect ratio.
EXIF-rotated and portrait/landscape test images are covered.
The crop package is retained only if a documented spike proves it suitable.

tasks.title: Connect preview, export, share and print
tasks.objective: Complete the user flow from a selected image to a named PDF.
acceptance: Preview reflects all current print-job settings.
Export produces a stable, sanitised filename.
Share and print errors are recoverable and user-readable.
The flow works offline.
Integration tests cover the happy path with fake gateways.

tasks.title: Warn about insufficient image resolution
tasks.objective: Calculate effective DPI for the chosen physical output and warn without blocking export.
acceptance: DPI uses source pixels after crop and exact output inches.
Thresholds are documented and worded as guidance, not guarantees.
The warning never changes physical dimensions.
Boundary cases are unit-tested.

tasks.title: Generate calibration and print guidance
tasks.objective: Provide a 50 mm reference square and precise instructions for actual-size printing.
acceptance: Calibration PDF geometry is automatically verified.
Guidance explains 100% / actual size and warns against fit-to-page.
The feature is available before purchase.
The app does not claim control over printer-driver scaling.

tasks.title: Measure a physical calibration print
tasks.objective: Print and measure the generated 50 mm square on real hardware.
acceptance: A human records device, OS, printer, print route and scaling setting.
Both square dimensions are measured and recorded.
The result is linked to an exact commit.
Any deviation greater than 1 mm is investigated before release.

tasks.title: Implement export allowance and entitlement model
tasks.objective: Allow one complete free export and represent a lifetime entitlement independently of store APIs.
acceptance: Preview and calibration never consume the free export.
A successful normal export consumes it exactly once.
Failed or cancelled exports do not consume it.
Lifetime entitlement bypasses the allowance.
State-transition tests cover reinstall/restore assumptions explicitly.

tasks.title: Integrate the lifetime store purchase
tasks.objective: Buy and restore one non-consumable product through a testable purchase gateway.
acceptance: in_app_purchase is isolated behind PurchaseGateway.
Pending, purchased, restored, cancelled and failed states are handled.
The UI states clearly that the purchase is one-time.
Restore purchases is accessible.
Purchase tokens and receipts are never logged.

tasks.title: Validate sandbox purchases on Android and iPhone
tasks.objective: Exercise purchase, cancellation and restoration using real sandbox/test accounts.
acceptance: Purchase and restore succeed on both platforms.
Cancellation leaves entitlement unchanged.
Evidence records app version, device and test date.
Store product names and one-time pricing are reviewed.

tasks.title: Localise the app in Spanish and English
tasks.objective: Move all user-visible copy into Flutter localisation resources and cover both launch languages.
acceptance: No production user-visible string is hard-coded in a widget.
Spanish and English flows fit supported phone sizes.
Units and decimal formatting follow locale expectations.
Widget tests run in both locales.

tasks.title: Confirm app identity and store ownership
tasks.objective: Confirm final display name, bundle IDs and store accounts before signing configuration is locked.
acceptance: Final Android application ID is registered/available.
Final iOS bundle ID is registered/available.
Developer display name and support contact are recorded.
Any identity change is applied consistently in code and store metadata.

tasks.title: Prepare store metadata, privacy and release automation
tasks.objective: Create versioned listings, screenshots, privacy disclosures and protected release workflows.
acceptance: Store copy and screenshots live under store/ for both locales.
Privacy disclosures match local-only processing and actual dependencies.
Android AAB and iOS archive jobs use protected environments and no committed secrets.
Release notes derive from CHANGELOG.md.
Internal-track upload can be invoked without changing source files.

tasks.title: Review and submit version 1.0
tasks.objective: Perform final real-device review and submit the release in both stores.
acceptance: The final build is tested on at least one supported Android phone and iPhone.
Screenshots, pricing, privacy answers and support information are reviewed.
The Android production release is submitted.
The iOS production release is submitted.
Store review outcomes are recorded.
